releases.title: Complete armor sets load from website folders
improved: Open the outer downloaded folder once, check the detected set and piece count, then choose Add whole set and Review complete set.
Parent collections and extraction wrappers can reveal their contained armor sets; each selected set keeps its own complete piece list.
The complete 89-page guide explains website armor folders while retaining all 33 Studio chapters and the existing allocation, movement checks and reviewed saves.
fixed: Complete armor set recognises the website's extracted per-set downloads with pieces/folder/layer and items/files/layer manifests, alongside existing sets collections.
Missing or ambiguous source assets are identified before adding a set, and a failed folder load clears stale set choices.
releases.note: Extract the download before importing. Each wearable piece needs its own icon, equipment VD and male/female paperdolls. Source IDs remain references; allocation, movement checks and reviewed saves are retained. A whole-suit VD cannot be split automatically. Final combined fit and movement require a receiving-client check.

releases.title: Animated items and spell effects have clear import choices
added: Import Animation offers Animated items, Spell / visual effects, Body / character animations and Mounts / rideable objects.
Direct Animated items and Spell / visual effects entries in Import artwork and All tools.
improved: Animated items/effects start with native item animation enabled and retain it when loading ordered frame folders or ZIPs.
Item/effect previews and help explain consecutive artwork frames, native timing and optional visual-effect scripts.
Queue native art, TileData, AnimData and supported linked Sphere scripts, then use Content packs → Export pending bundle before saving to share a .uoasset ZIP container.
The complete 89-page guide distinguishes item/effect distribution from body VD files and retains all 33 Studio chapters.
releases.note: Item/effect .uoasset export uses the reviewed pending bundle before saving. VD carries native body animation rather than item artwork/AnimData. Optional effect scripts play visuals; combat behaviour and C# script distribution remain separate. Recipient client/server checks remain required.

releases.title: Practical editing, building and inspection tools
added: Gump artwork selection, layer controls, snapping, alignment and a local Test / Interact window for pages, inputs and reply IDs.
Individual item/gump images can be opened in an installed graphics editor, returned to a preview and reviewed for replacement at the same asset ID.
Optional House Builder kits from client tables, reusable named stamps and an individual Problems list.
Optional small pictures of completed world-generation stages, with a separate viewer.
Tool readiness alongside File details distinguishes missing and damaged required files and identifies valid source alternatives.
improved: Complete gump Undo/Redo includes layout, property and layer changes; native client artwork retains its fixed dimensions.
Animations and Test Scene use bounded preview caches with source-aware invalidation.
All pieces and custom house palettes remain available when optional building tables are absent. Stamp placement has a ghost preview and one undo step.
The complete user guide is now 88 pages across the existing 33 chapters. All 863 final application checks passed.
fixed: World-generation settings changes keep the export state clear, including changes made while generation completes.
releases.note: Image replacements still require review before saving. Gump interaction, house checks and generation pictures are local inspection aids; readiness checks native file structure rather than every image, action or server definition. Matching stamp artwork and final client/shard checks remain required.

releases.title: Clear artwork imports and tools grouped by task
added: Home has five direct buttons: Import Tiles, Import Statics, Import Gumps, Import Animation and Import Mounts.
The Import artwork sidebar page keeps those five choices together in both Simple and Advanced modes.
All tools shows 34 tools under visible headings: Import artwork, Browse & preview, Server scripts, Build worlds and Files & distribution.
improved: Tiles starts with floor, wall and roof item art. Statics starts with placed items and props, then lets you review their artwork, properties and destinations.
Gumps opens PNG/BMP interface-art import directly. Animation opens the VD, GIF or frame importer, and Mounts opens the mount VD workflow with its shrink-icon and server settings.
Tool search, category filters and Enter to open the first result remain available. Creature, armor, clothing and effect imports are retained.
Standalone VD conversion and whole-body animation export remain available alongside the new direct import choices.
releases.note: Tiles and Statics use static item-art slots. Tile-pack preview exclusions, PNG preference, Remove selected, native format checks and reviewed saves remain available. Link a working client for imports; standalone VD conversion can still write a separate file without installing it.

releases.title: Tile packs import artwork instead of preview grids
added: Advanced adds Include preview folders and Include both PNG and BMP versions. Choose these before reopening the folder or ZIP.
Remove selected removes rows from the import list without deleting the source files. Multiple selected rows can be removed together.
Source status shows the imported image count and the skipped preview-folder and BMP-alternative counts.
fixed: Folder and ZIP imports skip folders named previews by default and prefer PNG when a BMP with the same name is in the same folder.
Review checks loaded images before allocating artwork slots. Unsupported images identify their filename and dimensions with guidance to remove preview grids or prepare compatible art.
improved: Choose images retains explicitly selected files; opening a previews folder itself remains an explicit choice. Source dimensions and native static-art limits are retained.
The complete 84-page guide explains tile-pack selection, Advanced overrides, Remove selected and artwork-limit troubleshooting across its existing 33 chapters.
releases.note: Default exclusions apply to folder and ZIP imports. A previews folder is matched by name without regard to capitalization; alternate image pairs require the same folder and filename stem. Choose images is unchanged. Unsupported artwork is not resized automatically, and client files change only after the reviewed save.

releases.title: Website update checks and an installer you choose
added: Studio checks the current version on the UO Workshop website after startup and offers an update when a newer stable version is available.
Updates > Check now lets you check again whenever you choose. The remembered startup-check option applies across profiles.
The update download shows progress and can be cancelled before installation. The installer is checked against its published byte count and SHA256 before it can run.
improved: You decide whether to update. Continue working with Later, and save or resolve pending work before Studio closes for installation.
Website checks and downloads run in the background; Studio remains usable when the website is unavailable or you are offline.
The installer updates the existing application while retaining your profiles and keeping client data, scripts, accounts and saves separate.
releases.note: Install 0.32.3 once to receive the updater. Older installations can use the website installer. Downloading an update does not install it automatically. The complete guide covers update checks, download cancellation, verification and manual installation.

releases.title: Corrected UOP body exports and visible saving progress
added: Reviewed game-file saves and Save All show a moving activity bar, the current file and its position in the bundle, plus elapsed minutes and seconds.
After files are saved, a visible refresh phase reports script-reading counts, reference resolution and folder refresh.
fixed: Whole-body UOP export reads the same last valid recognized mobtypes.txt definition as the viewer, fixing duplicate entries such as body 1729.
Supported Animal conversion accepts the additional 0x2000 animation flag, including body 1638’s combined 0x12000 flags.
A second native death slot reuses the first pose only when AnimationSequence explicitly aliases that second source action to the same pose.
improved: Script indexing and folder reads run in the background once after a save; binary-only saves skip unnecessary script indexing.
A refresh error after writing explains that the files were already saved. The completed queue is cleared while open script drafts remain intact.
The complete 83-page guide covers corrected body lookup, conditional riding variants and saving/refresh feedback.
releases.note: The complete ZIP preserves every physical UOP group. A separate riding VD requires an available mapped riding mode; physical groups alone do not establish one. Absent native slots 4 and 11 remain empty. The save activity bar shows ongoing work rather than a time-remaining estimate. Game-file save controls remain disabled until saving and refresh finish; there is no midway cancellation. Receiving-client and shard checks remain necessary.

releases.title: Whole-body VD export and complete UOP Animal bundles
added: Animations now has Save entire body as .vd: enter a body ID, choose Source Auto, Load body and save all available native MUL actions and stored facings.
Supported UOP ANIMAL bodies use their AnimationSequence mode/action tables to create a standard 13-action Animal VD.
A collision-free complete ZIP preserves all physical UOP groups in archival 35-action-layout VDs, with a separate riding 13-action VD when mode 2 exists, mapping JSON and a public README.
improved: Export uses the typed body and selected source rather than the current preview, verifies staged output and marks results from a previous project.
The complete 83-page guide explains Auto source routing, five stored facings and eight mirrored display directions, ordinary imports and archival preservation files.
fixed: Empty bulk scans now say No files exported and identify the selected range/source with alias and UOP guidance, instead of reporting a zero-file success.
VD-only exports still report success when VD files were produced without PNG frames.
releases.note: Archival 35-action files preserve physical UOP groups and are not ordinary Animal imports. A generic source fidget may be reused for native Eat/Fidget slots; no distinct eating pose is generated. Unsupported native Animal slots 4 and 11 remain empty. Native MUL source gaps are retained and reported. UOP conversion requires visible frames in all five stored facings of every source group and rejects a blank facing or unsupported layout before saving. Server definitions, icons, sounds and riding setup remain separate distribution assets.

releases.title: Simple and Advanced modes, clearer navigation and direct VD conversion
added: Simple and Advanced modes with shared preferences: use automatic free-slot selection and conversion defaults, or reveal manual formats, IDs, alignment and replacement choices.
Detailed hover help explains controls, their output and relevant native-format limits.
Save GIF, PNG/BMP or exported animation sequences directly as verified native VD files without installing them.
Convert all supplied stored sequences in an exported body folder into one verified VD, retaining action IDs and ground origins.
improved: Home focuses on common tasks, the Simple sidebar is shorter, and All tools or Ctrl+K retains access to every editor.
Switching between modes preserves manual values and restores them when returning to Advanced.
Shared save controls and task descriptions reduce repeated routes and make the first workflow easier to follow.
The complete PDF, browser and offline guide cover the new modes and direct conversion steps.
releases.note: 507 tests passed in separate historical and current-feature runs. The frozen-runtime self-test and installer compilation passed; interactive installed startup remains unverified. A sequence VD contains one action/facing; body-folder conversion includes only supplied stored sequences and skips mirrored previews. Conversion does not create missing movement, riding or server behaviour.

releases.title: Classic UO landscapes, script recipes and ethereal mounts
added: Save and reopen portable script recipes, and preview generated source and creation commands before saving.
Classic UO mountain edges with craggy rock faces, uneven ridges and separate bounded slope limits.
World overview Height, Slope and Shoreline / blends views, plus Terrain review with clickable inspection coordinates.
improved: Raised terrain previews use square client terrain textures and optional TexTerr.def mappings, with artwork fallback when textures are absent.
Natural cave entrances use native black rock-mouth artwork and a clear dirt approach, with a trigger in front of the wall pieces.
Paths seek any reachable earlier clearing and avoid cutting diagonally through blocked shore corners.
The complete manual now has 71 pages covering the new controls.
fixed: Sphere Rideable object mounts now mount directly from their backpack item and return that same item on dismount, without leaving a loose creature.
Generated mount helpers join related-content removal only when unchanged; external references and customized helpers remain protected.
releases.note: 471 unittests passed. Three sample exports and a full-size 7168 × 4096 terrain review passed. Connected-player Sphere checks cover mounting, dismounting, repeat clicks, denied mounting and cleanup. Custom shard hooks, death and restart still need shard-specific testing. Packaged startup remains unverified; source runtime, frozen archive and installer compilation were checked.

releases.title: Legacy UOP maps load correctly in Map Regions
improved: Standard facet sizes are detected automatically, including 6144 × 4096 and 7168 × 4096 Britannia maps; custom maps retain manual dimensions.
Loaded dimensions are displayed above the terrain preview; the 68-page guide explains map loading.
fixed: Corrected legacy UOP terrain chunk addressing, fixing the incorrect map-dimensions error for map0LegacyMUL.uop and other standard maps.
Accepted the standard optional trailing padding block while retaining checks for missing, truncated or mismatched terrain data.
Cancelling custom dimensions keeps the current preview and its coordinate scale unchanged.
releases.note: 450 unittests passed. All six standard client-map overviews and independent terrain samples were checked without changing the inputs. Packaged launch remains unverified; source runtime, GUI, frozen archive and installer compilation passed.

releases.title: A redesigned workspace and Sphere Map Regions
added: Home task cards, permanent editor navigation and a searchable All tools page with 26 workflows.
Map Regions for Sphere: select, draw, move, add and remove AREADEF / ROOMDEF boundaries.
Guarded, safe, spell, recall, gate, teleport, PvP and other region-rule controls with reviewed script saves.
Appearance page with ten themes, Standard/Larger text and a panel-layout reset.
improved: Editors remember optional Definitions and Script files panels; save and profile controls are grouped.
Tile imports now separate artwork previews from properties and animation; equipment stats use a compact layout.
The complete PDF and offline guide now cover 33 chapters across 68 pages.
fixed: Restored and switched editor layouts keep useful panel widths on smaller windows.
Region saves preserve custom tags/events and encoding, with script conflicts checked before writes.
releases.note: Map Regions targets Sphere only. Terrain is read-only; custom events, region ordering and final guard/travel behaviour require shard testing. Keep a covering world region and stop Sphere before saving. Packaged executable launch remains unverified; source runtime, GUI, frozen archive and installer compilation are checked.

releases.title: Static tile packs, ModernUO preview and better worlds
added: Import static walls, floors and items from PNG/BMP folders or ZIPs, with optional subfolders, sorted previews and reviewed free-slot placement.
ModernUO preview script target for official 0.15.6.198, using native generated serialization and UOContent destinations.
Find area shortcuts for coast, forest, desert, snow, mountain, volcano and path previews.
improved: Smoother biome boundaries and distance-aware river routing in generator version 2.
Tree spacing accounts for canopy size while keeping trunk and canopy pieces paired.
World exports report missing shoreline-art matches; the guide covers the new imports and target limits.
fixed: Changed world settings now mark the preview outdated and require regeneration before export.
Non-dyeable C# armor no longer generates an unsupported Dye override.
Script workshop instructions and world summaries fit better in smaller windows.
releases.note: ModernUO passed source and syntax checks; a full ModernUO build and shard testing remain required. Existing definition, sound-link, removal, house/deed and world entrance script workflows remain Sphere. Older world settings regenerate with the new rules; keep previous native exports for exact layouts.

releases.title: Sphere, RunUO and ServUO scripts
added: Choose Sphere, official RunUO 2.x or ServUO pub57 when importing monsters, mounts, items, effects, clothing and weapons.
Choose one script target for a complete armor set, including whole-folder imports.
Generate scripts for artwork already installed through Workspace → Workshops → Generate server script.
C# templates include spellcasting, healing, taming, triggered effects, temporary summons, equipment bonuses and weapon hit effects.
improved: Review the generated source, destination and GM creation command before saving. Check existing filenames and C# class names, including combined or restored queues.
Updated the complete guide to 65 pages with target-specific export instructions.
releases.note: RunUO and ServUO both use C#, with separate templates for their APIs. Existing definition editing, sound-link editing, removal, house/deed and world entrance scripts remain Sphere workflows. Generated scripts still need gameplay testing on the chosen server.

releases.title: Creature behaviour and abilities
added: Eight editable creature presets in Monster and Mount imports.
Configure damage, skills, resistances, normal spells, healing, taming, follower slots and food.
Add abilities with a trigger, percentage chance, cooldown, health threshold and range: spell effects, self-healing, custom attack visuals, sound, temporary summons or a compatible Sphere function.
Configure summoned creatures, quantity, living limit and lifetime, with cleanup when the summoner dies or is deleted.
improved: Full generated-script review and an expanded creature-behaviour guide. Rideable objects retain their separate no-taming/no-feeding mode.

releases.title: Dungeons, caves and equipment bonuses
added: Reserve a black off-world area for connected stone dungeons and natural caves.
Generate graded cave openings in the main map, paired interior locations and optional two-way Sphere entrance/return scripts.
Follow entrances and return locations in World Explorer.
Add weapon and armor stat bonuses or penalties, Luck, five resistances, combat modifiers, skill bonuses and percentage-based on-hit spells.
Copy a piece’s equipment effects to the rest of an armor set.
improved: Real terrain elevation, slightly uneven ground and bounded slopes remain consistent between the explorer and exported map. Sea water stays at height zero.
Guide expanded to cover underground areas, sound replacement and equipment effects.
releases.note: Generated maps are separate exports. Regions, spawns, loot and server activation remain separate work; Test Scene does not execute combat scripts.

releases.title: World Explorer and current sound links
added: Open the generated world in a separate, resizable explorer window.
Pan by dragging or using the keyboard, zoom with the mouse wheel, navigate with the minimap and jump to volcanoes, lakes and clearings.
See and listen to sounds already associated with an asset, including resolved creature inheritance.
improved: Replace a selected sound link without adding a second command. A newly imported sound can keep the old shared audio available to other assets.
Scenery and grid switches help inspect terrain; the explorer draws nearby tiles as you travel.

releases.title: World Generator
added: Generate seeded continents, islands and archipelagos with deserts, icy regions, rivers, lakes, mountains, paths, trees and foliage.
Add volcanic cones and craters, adjust tree size/density and foliage, and paint biome regions.
Save generation settings, inspect native terrain previews and export a separate map set with overview, heightmap and checksums.
improved: Terrain limits constrain elevation and neighbouring height differences; coastlines and biome boundaries blend through native transition artwork.
Water remains level, and trees avoid paths and restricted ground.
fixed: Corrected map UOP output to use directly readable terrain chunks and the proper internal names for alternate map files.

releases.title: Workspace sounds and MUL to UOP
added: Attach sound directly from the visible Sound in UO panel above the Workspace preview.
Convert supported MUL art, gumps, sounds and terrain maps to UOP, alongside the existing UOP-to-MUL direction.
Convert High Seas multis with their matching housing and component companion files.
improved: Sound attachment follows the asset shown in Workspace, independently of another open script.
Converters verify output in a new folder and preserve source files. Animations and separate metadata are outside this conversion workflow.

releases.title: Sound attachments and checks before saving
added: Attach an existing client sound or ready-made PCM WAV from a definition’s context menu or the Sound workshop.
Choose creature idle/notice/hit/hurt/death, item use/equip/unequip or supported function sound links, then listen and review.
improved: Check destinations, relevant client archives and write access before creating backups or staging a save; check again before replacement.
Apply destination checks to direct script saves and backup restoration.
Save new sound data and its script link together while retaining existing script conditions and inheritance.

releases.title: House Builder refinements and complete guide
added: Automatic house-project recovery, Save project as and links to earlier compiled houses.
Material palettes, favourites, recent pieces, readable tile names, Line and Perimeter tools, placement previews, floor-height presets and editable selection properties.
Walk testing with keyboard or click-to-walk, stairs and nearby door interaction; checks for low headroom, unreachable floors and enclosed floor gaps.
The first comprehensive distribution guide, covering the complete application.
improved: Saving or queueing a compiled house leaves its editable project open.
Compiled projects remember their house ID and script, allowing reviewed updates to the same house with changed-destination checks.
fixed: Invalid house projects now report an error without replacing the current design.
releases.note: Already placed houses retain their saved structure. Redeed and place a fresh house to apply structural changes.

releases.title: House Builder and generated housing deeds
added: Build with native floors, walls, roofs and decorations in an isometric editor.
Paint, rectangle, erase, select, copy/paste, move, adjust heights, undo/redo and toggle roof visibility.
Save editable house projects and exchange unhued CentrED CSV blueprints.
Compile a fixed native multi with its Sphere house/deed script through one reviewed save, supporting MUL and UOP multi files.

releases.title: More equipment space and permission verification
added: Opt-in Expand equipment capacity if needed in Armor set and Equipped appearance.
Extend the primary animation index with blank records for otherwise unused equipment IDs up to 2047 when existing capacity is exhausted.
improved: Show expansion in the save review and retain original index length for recovery; existing animation mappings and paperdolls remain protected.
fixed: Verify and restore the original Windows access rules after replacement, including older permission descriptors. This strengthens the permission-preservation fix from 0.22.1.

releases.title: Import a whole armor set from a folder
added: Open a set or collection folder and add every piece’s icon, VD and male/female paperdolls together.
Load all four files for an individual piece from its folder.
Recognise supported collection manifests and named piece subfolders.
improved: Suggest free destination IDs while excluding queued pieces. Package reference IDs are not treated as installation destinations.
Keep every piece editable before the combined save review.

releases.title: Preserve Windows file permissions
fixed: Addressed client saves carrying temporary-file permissions onto the destination and losing normal folder inheritance.
Preserve existing access permissions through reviewed saves, script editing and recovery; record permissions for files that may need recreation.
releases.note: Version 0.22.3 adds further verification for older Windows permission descriptors. The current installer includes both changes.

releases.title: Complete armor-set imports
added: Build a complete set from independently wearable pieces, each with its own inventory icon, animation and male/female paperdolls.
Allocate destinations and generate matching scripts under scripts/armor.
Review and save the whole set in one recoverable operation.
improved: Check duplicate layers, IDs and identifiers, and exclude earlier pieces from automatic slot suggestions.
releases.note: Each piece still needs its own artwork and equipped appearance. A single whole-suit VD cannot be split automatically into independent pieces.

releases.title: Organised script folders
improved: Place new generated scripts into relevant folders for monsters, mounts, items, clothing, weapons, effects and assets.
Register new resource paths when needed, while preserving existing script locations.

releases.title: Equipment paperdoll preview
added: Preview a selected equippable item on a small paperdoll.
Show selected equipment on the player model in Test Scene, linking the inventory item to its equipped appearance.

releases.title: Ten interface themes
added: Choose from ten interface colour themes.
improved: Apply a theme throughout the app and remember the selected appearance between sessions.

releases.title: Delete scripts from the directory
added: Right-click a script in the script directory to review its deletion.
improved: Include script removal in the recoverable save workflow, with directory/editor refresh and protection against changed files.

releases.title: Send assets to Test Scene
added: Right-click in Item Assets, Animations or Asset spaces and choose Show in Test Scene.
Open the selected asset directly in the scene without entering its ID again.

releases.title: Place items without replacing the character
fixed: Selecting and placing an item in Test Scene no longer needs to turn the character into that item.
added: Place selected items as separate scene props.
Room walls cover both back edges, with extra test walls for checking movement and overlap.

releases.title: Scene walls and walking directions
fixed: Corrected the Test Scene wall presentation.
Aligned character facing with the direction of travel in the isometric scene.

releases.title: Tidy Test Scene controls
improved: Organised the sidebar into Preview and Room controls.
Show controls relevant to the selected asset kind and make scene setup easier to navigate.

releases.title: The in-app Test Scene
added: Preview characters, mounts, equipment, items and effects in a native isometric room.
Try eight directions, actions, playback speed, frame stepping, hue, lighting and zoom.
Move locally, test wall collision, place props, change floors/walls and export PNG snapshots.
Preview queued changes or external VD, PNG and GIF files before importing them.
releases.note: A visual sandbox inside Studio; it does not run a server, execute gameplay scripts or write scene changes to game files.

releases.title: Custom mounts, layout and removal fixes
added: Import compatible 35-action custom mount VDs with the required mounted and unmounted poses.
Choose Rideable object for inventory-activated mounts without animal taming or feeding.
Review removal of a definition, its linked assets, or a wider animation-related group, while checking external references.
improved: The installer detects an existing installation, reuses its folder and supports same-version repair.
Keep all three main panes usable at startup and save-review actions accessible when the details area needs scrolling.
fixed: Read and preserve legacy script bytes that previously caused charmap decoding errors.
Distinguish item and creature references with the same numeric ID, reducing false removal blockers.
Clean up eligible empty .scp files and their exact resource registrations after removal; refresh the script directory.
Handle mount remnants from earlier partial removals, including linked figurine aliases, while retaining shared or externally referenced content.
releases.note: Several follow-up builds kept the 0.20.2 version number. Their verified changes are collected here; unrelated references still require review.

releases.title: Create mount icons from animation poses
added: Choose an action, direction and frame from the mount animation as its shrink icon.
Trim transparent edges, mirror the pose and choose its maximum size without exporting an intermediate PNG.
improved: Save the new icon, TileData and Sphere ICON link together in a separate free item slot.
Clear an old pose selection when switching to another VD.

releases.title: Connected Workspace and workshops
added: Connected Workspace and Studio tools for animation editing, layered previews, sounds, a visual Sphere gump designer and multiple script tabs.
Save/session recovery, project comparison, test copies, favourites and portable content packs.
improved: Combine non-conflicting archive edits and reserve queued import IDs during automatic placement.
Persist drafts and queued recipes per project, show converted before/after images, cache thumbnails and resume bulk exports.

releases.title: Bulk export and quick artwork replacement
added: Bulk-export item artwork and animation frames to organised PNG folders with progress, cancellation and frame-alignment metadata.
Export complete MUL animation bodies as individual VD files.
Right-click item or gump previews to replace their artwork through the existing save review.
releases.note: Modern UOP body animations export to PNG; their VD mapping is not guessed.

releases.title: Save verification and file checks
added: Check game files to inspect structure and identify mismatched editor/server UO folders without changing files.
fixed: Corrected quoted comments in equipconv.def, decimal Sphere item IDs, equipment gump reservations and mixed binary-preview folders.
improved: Verify complete fixed-record copies, protect retained backups from overwriting later edits and improve preview-worker cleanup.

releases.title: Automatic free-space placement
added: Automatically suggest compatible free destinations for item/effect frames, gumps, creature animations, mounts and equipment bundles.
improved: Review the selected range, switch to manual IDs or find another free space, and recheck destinations before saving.
Require a complete compatible block instead of splitting an import or silently overwriting content.

releases.title: Clothing and weapon imports
added: Import clothing and weapons with inventory icons, TileData layers, equipped animation and male/female paperdolls.
Reuse an existing equipped appearance or import a compatible 35-action equipment VD.
Choose weapon families and edit combat properties, clothing layers, dyeability and armor values.
improved: Review icon, paperdoll, animation coverage and generated Sphere script as one linked change.

releases.title: Save controls, navigation and UOP conversion
added: Save scripts, Save game files, Save All and a Pending changes queue.
Back/Forward navigation with Alt+Left and Alt+Right shortcuts.
Batch UOP-to-MUL conversion for supported art, gumps, sounds, maps and multis into a separate folder.
improved: Checkpoint pending imports with sessions; prompt about unsaved changes before closing or switching profiles.

releases.title: Continuous asset galleries
added: Continuous scrolling galleries for item/animation spaces and gumps, with search and used/free filters.
Load more UOP animation bodies as browsing reaches the end of the current range.
improved: Load nearby thumbnails through a bounded cache.
Simplify profiles to the server, client-data folder and optional client executable.

releases.title: Shard profiles and installer builds
added: Named shard profiles with create, rename, copy, remove and switch actions.
Linked-folder shortcuts and remembered startup profile.
Windows installer packaging with bundled runtime, Start menu entry, optional desktop shortcut and uninstaller.
improved: Protect unsaved edits and retain the current profile if the new locations cannot be opened.

releases.title: Mount shrink icons
added: Choose an existing icon with search and thumbnails, or import a PNG/BMP into a free item slot.
Generate the Sphere icon/figurine links and save them with the mount and riding memory.
fixed: Corrected UOP artwork imports that also update TileData in the same save.

releases.title: Compressed gump previews
fixed: Decode Mythic-compressed UOP gumps that previously failed to preview.
Recognise compressed empty placeholders and include higher UOP gump IDs.
improved: Start the gump browser with Used selected and improve platform-specific build checks.

releases.title: UO Asset Studio and visual asset spaces
added: Introduced the UO Asset Studio name and neutral generated-script naming.
Visual Asset spaces with thumbnails, IDs, source selection and used/free candidates.
Dedicated Mount import with linked animation, riding memory, metadata and script review.
Compare hues across selected clothing/item artwork.
improved: Double-click a definition to open its relevant asset viewer, with properties, references and script ready alongside it.

releases.title: Gumps and hues
added: Browse, search, preview and export native MUL/UOP gumps, and import image batches through save review.
Browse hue palettes, compare original/recoloured artwork and edit swatches, gradients and names.
Exchange UOFiddler hue text palettes, export hue lists and copy Sphere colour/gump helper lines.

releases.title: Linked asset and Sphere script imports
added: Guided Monster, Item and Effect imports with generated Sphere scripts.
Inspect slots, set identifiers/categories and review client assets and registered scripts together.
improved: Validate compatible VD layouts, animation routing and destination references before a linked save.

releases.title: Direct client editing and recovery
added: Edit TileData and flags, import static artwork, create animated items and import creature animations.
Batch image ordering, consecutive or filename-based IDs, converted previews and replacement checks.
Recoverable multi-file saves with staging verification, optional retained backups, rollback and interrupted-save recovery.

releases.title: Script creation and animation exports
added: Create script folders and .scp files from the directory context menu.
Animation playback-speed presets and GIF export with frame alignment.
Guided Add item form with artwork preview, categories, identifier checks and script review.

releases.title: Animation browsing and script directory
added: Preview MUL/UOP body animations by action and direction, with playback, frame stepping, zoom and frame export.
Browse the script directory and edit whole script files alongside individual definitions.
Back up original scripts manually or before opening them for editing.
improved: Protect unsaved edits during navigation and preserve script encoding and line endings.
